record.claim: *Three turn-end hooks, one shared resource.* All three hooks write to the turn's closing message, producing three conflict edges. The governance model computes an execution order, but the generic runtime driver that would enforce it has not yet been implemented.
record.topology: Ordered three hooks all write one shared resource; declared order distinguished from unimplemented runtime.
required_terms: One shared slot: the turn's closing message
25 mechanisms; 3 conflict edges. Topological sort computes the order; a cycle is an error. Generic runtime enforcement is not yet implemented.
record.bw_encoding: White ordinary nodes and groups; labels and boundaries carry roles without decorative tones.
record.redesign: Native nodes and routed edges preserve the original semantic structure, with print-sized labels and fewer decorative frames. Grayscale refinement: Hooks paired by fill; modeled-order arrows strengthened separately from resource writes.
record.alt: Three governance mechanisms, all firing when an agent ends a turn: one discourages premature stops, one prompts reflection on failures, one checks for stranded work. Black arrows labelled modeled order between them show the modeled order, left to right. All three write the same shared resource below — the turn's closing message. An annotation notes that the typed governance graph holds twenty-five mechanisms, that these three edges are its only conflicts, and that the order is computed by topological sort, with a cycle reported as an error.
